import 'package:conflux/conflux.dart';

enum Color { red, blue }
void main() {
  final Schema<String> text = Val.string().email().optional().required().maxLength(100);
  final Schema<int> integer = Val.int().min(0).safe().multipleOf(1);
  final Schema<double> decimal = Val.double().max(2.0).positive();
  final Schema<num> number = Val.number().negative();
  final Schema<bool> boolean = Val.boolean();
  final Schema<int> literal = Val.literal(1);
  final Schema<String> stringEnum = Val.enumString(['a']);
  final Schema<Color> enumValue = Val.enumValues([Color.red]);
  final Schema<Color> instance = Val.instance<Color>();
  final Schema<List<String?>> list = Val.list(Val.string().nullable()).unique();
  final Schema<Map<String, int>> map = Val.map(integer);
  final ObjectSchema<Map<String, Object?>> object = Val.object({'count': integer}).partial();
  final ObjectSchema<Map<String, Object?>?> nullableObject = object.nullable().extend({'color': enumValue.optional()});
  final Schema<Object> union = Val.anyOf<Object>([integer, boolean]);
  final Schema<Object> json = Val.any();
  final Schema<Map<String, Object?>> discriminated = Val.discriminated(discriminatorKey: 'kind', schemas: {
    'a': Val.object({'kind': Val.literal('a')})
  });
  late final Schema<Map<String, Object?>> node;
  node = Val.lazy(() => Val.object({'children': Val.list(node).optional()}));
  final Schema<Moment> moment = Val.moment();
  final Schema<Moment> converted = Val.string().moment();
  final Schema<String> id = Val.chronoId();
  final Schema<String> timestamp = Val.string().datetime();
  final Schema<Object?> widened = integer;
  final widenedResult = widened.refine((value) => value is int).parse(1);
  final outputs = <Object?>[
    text.parse('a@b.co'), integer.parse(1), decimal.parse(1.0), number.parse(-1), boolean.parse(true),
    literal.parse(1), stringEnum.parse('a'), enumValue.parse(Color.red), instance.parse(Color.blue),
    list.parse([null]), map.parse({'a': 1}), object.parse({}), nullableObject.parse(null),
    union.parse(1), json.parse([null]), discriminated.parse({'kind': 'a'}), node.parse({}),
    moment.parse(converted.parse('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')),
    id.parse('000000000000000000000000'), timestamp.parse('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), widenedResult,
  ];
  if (outputs.length != 21) throw StateError('Incomplete catalog fixture');
}
